**Finding: MISSING — no performance warranty (WARRANTY rule).**

- **Investigation:** Section 9 ("Warranties", p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate-existence/authority reps and a Globix acknowledgement. Article 1 (p0005–p0014) imposes design/host/operate obligations and a 60-day go-live deadline with a termination right, but no conformance or performance warranty, no duration, and no remedy. Searches for "professional/workmanlike", "conform/documentation/defect/repair/refund", and "AS IS"/disclaimer language returned nothing — so the express warranty is simply absent (there is at least no disclaimer swallowing it).
- **Classification:** Fails the fallback (no software conformance warranty, no services warranty, no remedy), so an insert is warranted.
- **Cure (fallback level, one operation):** New Section 9(c) after p0058 — 90-day conformance of the Site/software to its documentation, 30-day Services warranty, and repair, replacement or refund as remedies. No preferred-only extras (12 months, compliance with laws, no malicious code) and no ancillary boilerplate were added; Section 9 already survives under 10.7.
